disposition: Engineering completed at unit level for the native ClaudeTransport (procedure_002, fake launcher only). executedChecks.scope: Focused run, Python 3.13.11 on macOS 27.0.1; 27 transport tests plus 38 host tests, no skips (the transport tests use only a Python fake launcher and temporary files).

executedChecks.command: scratch mutation run: 14 single-line mutations of agent_braid/harness_transport_claude.py (subscription check, kill request, single attempt, hash pin, quota stop, executable/build/host-qualification/containment-qualification manifest comparisons, ENV_DENY check, pinned argv[0], version pin, _check_backend, post-hoc stdout feed), each followed by the transport module
executedChecks.scope: All 14 mutations were caught by at least one test; the file was restored after the run.

executedChecks.command: pre-PR reviews: correctness, quality, simplification (self-review of the diff)
executedChecks.scope: Run by the implementing Claude agent, not an independent review. Applied: run evidence carries the qualification, host qualification and executable hashes; test fixture cleanups (manifest setters, shutil cleanup, unused imports, a dead branch). Rejected: a retry-after-quota-stop path (the attempt is consumed on purpose), a timeout wrapper around the relay thread (the launcher owns wall time).

method: Actual offline unittest execution with a fake contained launcher and a temporary file as the pinned executable; no claude, no sandbox-exec, no dedicated account, no quota source, no network

negativeControls.API-key variables present: env-deny-present for each ENV_DENY name, before any launch (including the version probe)
negativeControls.cancellation before launch: cancelled-before-launch; the launcher is never called
negativeControls.executable hash differs from pin: executable-drift at the version probe, again at the run launch after a swap; executable-unavailable when missing, symlinked or relative
negativeControls.host qualification with an unqualified o: containment-unqualified (backend record expired or for another environment); invalid-backend (missing, simulated or record-less backend); live-init-unsupported (launcher without on_output); qualification-mismatch when the passed host record is not the backend's verified record
negativeControls.manifest declarations versus trusted val: qualification-mismatch for containment.qualificationSha256, hostQualificationSha256 and containment.backend; executable-mismatch for host.executableSha256; build-mismatch for host.build
negativeControls.no, expired, drifted or Codex qualificat: native-host-unqualified for missing, expired, other-environment and non-qualification input; host-mismatch when parsing a Codex record
negativeControls.non-subscription apiKeySource: group kill requested at the init line (one chunk, line by line and split mid-line; launcher honouring or ignoring the kill); stdout cut at the init line so no assistant or result event is accepted; terminal refused; assistant or result before init or an oversized first line gives init-missing
negativeControls.PATH shadowing of claude: every launch argv[0] equals the pinned absolute path, never the shadow copy placed first on PATH
negativeControls.quota stop: quota-stop with the T004 reason in run evidence for weekly above 80 %, extra usage, stale and missing readings, unit cap and probe cap; the session is never launched
negativeControls.second attempt after failure: attempt-exhausted after a launcher refusal (F4 reason surfaced, e.g. self-check-allowed) and after a success; exactly one session launch
negativeControls.version drift: version-drift when the probe reports another build; invalid-version for malformed output; the init build differing from the probe fails the run

outcome: New agent_braid/harness_transport_claude.py: NativeClaudeTransport (kind native) launches only through the backend's launch entry point. verify_containment (K2, called from run_claude through the new ClaudeTransport hook, default refusing) runs harness_lab._check_backend and compares the manifest's containment.qualificationSha256, containment.backend, hostQualificationSha256, host.executableSha256 and host.build with the backend's verified records and pinned policy. version() launches the pinned executable with --version and enforces the exact NC-4 build. run() refuses a second attempt, a tampered plan and ENV_DENY variables, calls the T004 gate (cohort or probe mode, fresh NC-6 reading, injected clock) and records the decision with the qualification and executable hashes in run_evidence, re-checks the executable hash, rewrites argv[0] to the absolute pinned path with NATIVE_ENV_ALLOW (K4), and streams stdout to an init watcher (K1) that requests the kill on a non-subscription apiKeySource or on assistant/result before init and cuts the output at the init line. harness_host_claude.py: HostLimits and the native label allow wall seconds up to NATIVE_MAX_WALL_SECONDS (1800, K3) while run_claude keeps the shared 60-second bound for the double; the ClaudeTransport.verify_containment hook (K2) is called by _check_transport after the existing checks.
